item.title: Calls for applications: NVIDIA’s 2027–2028 Graduate Fellowship Program is now officially open
item.description: Doctoral students can secure up to $60,000 in funding, mentorship, and a summer internship.
item.dc:creator: Funded Youth Opportunities
item.content:encoded:
NVIDIA is offering grants of up to $60,000, alongside mentorship and technical support, for doctoral students conducting innovative research relevant to NVIDIA technologies.

💡 Key Focus Areas

The program supports students working in AI, machine learning, robotics, computer graphics, autonomous vehicles, healthcare, high-performance computing, and related fields.

📋 Key Eligibility Requirements

  • Academic Level: Must have completed at least their first year of Ph.D.-level studies at the time of application.

  • Internship: Must be available for a mandatory in-person internship at an NVIDIA research office in summer 2027.

Share Funded Youth Opportunities

📅 Application Deadline: October 30, 2026.

Full details and apply on the NVIDIA website! 🔗 https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/applications-open-graduate-fellowship-awards-2026/

Don’t forget to subscribe and share this post with a Ph.D. student who should apply!

Thanks for reading! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.

item.title: 4 Paid Internships You Can Apply for Right Now — May/June 2026 Edition
item.description: From the United Nations to South Korea’s top research university — these are verified, currently open paid internship opportunities curated for Global South students and graduates.
item.dc:creator: Funded Youth Opportunities
item.content:encoded:
Internships are not just résumé lines. The right internship puts you inside the rooms where decisions are made, connects you to professionals who open doors, and gives you the kind of practical experience that no classroom can replicate.

Here are four paid internship opportunities that are currently open or preparing to open — all verified, all real, and all worth your attention.

Subscribe now

1. UNICEF Paid Internship Programme 2026

Who it’s for: Undergraduate, postgraduate, and PhD students, and recent graduates (within 2 years). All nationalities. Multiple fields.

What you get: Monthly stipend, potential travel and visa support, hands-on experience in humanitarian and development work across 190+ countries.

Formats: On-site, hybrid, and remote positions available.

Status: Open year-round — new positions posted regularly. Apply as soon as you find a match.

Apply: www.unicef.org/careers → Internship Opportunities

👉 Read the full guide to the UNICEF Internship Programme

Subscribe now

2. UNDP Paid Internship Programme 2026

Who it’s for: Students in the final year of their bachelor’s degree, graduate students, or recent graduates within one year. All nationalities. All major fields.

What you get: Monthly stipend ($200–$500+ depending on role), remote and in-person placements, experience inside the UN’s global development network across 170+ countries.

Spotlight: The UNDP Digital, AI, and Innovation Internship is a fully remote role with a $200–$500/month stipend — open to applicants worldwide.

Status: Open year-round — positions posted on a rolling basis. Several openings currently available.

Apply: www.undp.org/careers → Filter by Internship

👉 Read the full guide to the UNDP Internship Programme

Share

3. World Bank Group Pioneers Internship Programme 2027 — Prepare Now

Who it’s for: Final-year undergraduates, postgraduate students, and professionals with up to 6 years of experience. All nationalities. Open to all development-related fields.

What you get: Hourly paid placement, visa sponsorship, World Bank laptop, professional development, access to one of the world’s most influential development institutions.

Status: The 2026 cycle has closed. Applications for 2027 open in January 2027. Start preparing now.

Apply: www.worldbank.org/en/about/careers — bookmark for January 2027.

👉 Read the full preparation guide for the World Bank Pioneers

Subscribe now

4. GIST Global Internship Programme 2026 — South Korea

Who it’s for: International undergraduate seniors and Master’s students. All nationalities. STEM and related fields.

What you get: Fully funded — round-trip airfare, accommodation, stipend, 8 weeks of hands-on research at a leading South Korean university. No IELTS required.

Status: Open now. Programme starts July 2026. Apply promptly.

Apply: www.gist.ac.kr → Global Internship Programme

👉 Read the full guide to the GIST Global Internship

Remember This

An internship application is not a lottery ticket you throw in and forget. Every strong internship has a competitive pool.

What separates selected candidates is almost always the same thing: a focused, specific, well-researched application that connects their background to the organization’s actual work.

Take the time to tailor. It is always worth it.

Opportunity Intel will keep covering new internship openings as they come. Follow us on Substack and WhatsApp so nothing slips past you.

New opportunities added regularly. Share this roundup with someone who needs it.

Share

item.title: Global Change Summit 2026 in Amsterdam — Fully Funded International Youth Leadership Summit (Deadline: July 10, 2026)
item.description: The Global Change Summit returns for its 3rd edition in Amsterdam, Netherlands — bringing together leaders, entrepreneurs, academics, and changemakers from around the world for four days of dialogue
item.dc:creator: Funded Youth Opportunities
item.content:encoded:
The Global Change Summit is back — and this time, it is coming to Amsterdam.

Following the success of GCS 2024 in Casablanca, Morocco, and GCS 2025 in Istanbul, Turkey, the 3rd edition of the Global Change Summit will take place in the Netherlands from September 25–28, 2026. Applications for fully funded participation are open until July 10, 2026.

What Is the Global Change Summit?

The Global Change Summit is an international convening that brings together leaders, professionals, entrepreneurs, academics, policymakers, innovators, and emerging changemakers from around the world to exchange ideas, build meaningful connections, and engage in high-level discussions on leadership, innovation, sustainability, global cooperation, and social impact.

Each edition of the summit has been designed not just as a conference but as a platform for genuine collaboration — where participants leave not only with new knowledge but with new relationships, new projects, and new perspectives on global challenges.

The 2026 edition in Amsterdam continues that tradition, bringing the summit to one of Europe’s most internationally connected and innovation-focused cities.

What the Summit Offers

Selected fully funded participants receive:

  • Coverage of participation costs for the four-day summit programme

  • Access to all summit sessions, workshops, panels, and networking activities

  • A structured four-day immersive experience in Amsterdam from September 25–28

  • Connection to a global network of summit alumni and peers

  • Exposure to diverse perspectives across leadership, sustainability, entrepreneurship, and global cooperation.

Who Should Apply?

The summit is open to individuals from all countries and professional backgrounds. The working language is English. Ideal applicants include:

  • Young leaders and emerging professionals

  • Entrepreneurs and social innovators

  • Academics and researchers

  • Policymakers and civil society advocates

  • Students in final years of their programmes

  • Anyone committed to leadership, innovation, and global cooperation

How to Apply

Visit the official Global Change Summit application page: 🔗 theogpd.org → Global Change Summit 2026 → Apply

Complete the application form carefully before the deadline.

Deadline: July 10, 2026

Opportunity Intel does not process applications. Apply only through official GCS channels.

Amsterdam in September with a global room of changemakers. July 10 deadline. Apply now.
